# Copilot code review instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` at the repository root first; it is the source of truth for structure, commands and conventions.

## Language

Write review comments, and expect all deliverables (code comments, docs, commit messages, PR text), in English.
Runtime log and error messages are English too.
Manifest `description` fields are English by Scoop convention and are kept as is.

## Review checklist

- Manifests (`bucket/*.json`) follow the Scoop schema (`$schema` present) and have `version`, `description`, `homepage`, `license`, `url` (or `architecture`) and a non-empty `hash`. A missing or empty `hash` is always a finding.
- `checkver` and `autoupdate` are defined, and the `autoupdate` URL pattern (`$version`) matches what `checkver` extracts.
- Scripts in `bin/` run on both Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell Core (CI tests both); flag cmdlets or syntax specific to one of them.
- No secrets are committed. `GITHUB_TOKEN` is provided by Actions and must not be added as a secret.
- Commit and PR titles follow Conventional Commits.

## Do not flag

- Upper-case letters in manifest file names derived from the app name (for example `ElitesRNGAuraObserver.json`).
- English manifest `description` fields.
- `$schema` pointing at the `master` branch of `ScoopInstaller/Scoop`.
- The `README.md` Apps section: it is generated by `bin/update-readme.ps1` and must not be hand-formatted.
- Excavator pushing directly to `master` instead of opening PRs: this is intended.
